items.title: M6A Implement corpus index and deterministic seeds
items.context: Build versioned path heading hash indexing, structured Story identifier extraction, exact plus normalized variants, and byte-deterministic golden tests.
items.userSees: Identical Story and corpus inputs produce the same versioned seed and corpus-index artifacts.

happy.desc: Run the corpus-index and keyword-seed generators twice against the same Story and requirements corpus, then validate proofbound.corpus-index.v1 and proofbound.keyword-seeds.v1 -> both runs emit byte-identical, schema-valid artifacts whose paths, H1/H2 headings, sizes, hashes, exact identifiers, normalized variants, source types, refs, and weights match the checked-in golden fixtures; WHY: maps schema-tests, determinism-tests, and golden-fixtures to the user-visible promise of stable routing inputs

edge.desc: Vary filesystem enumeration order, locale/case, hyphen/underscore/slash/camelCase/acronym forms, empty optional fields, and unchanged file mtimes -> artifact bytes and ordering remain deterministic while original exact tokens are retained beside normalized variants and content changes alone update the appropriate hashes; WHY: proves determinism at real normalization and corpus-boundary conditions

adversarial.desc: Introduce duplicate aliases, traversal/symlink escape candidates, malformed Markdown headings, and a large irrelevant document -> unsafe paths are rejected, duplicates cannot perturb ordering or weights, the corpus remains constrained to configured requirements Markdown, and no document body enters a prompt; WHY: prevents a forged or hostile corpus from invalidating the golden schema/determinism guarantees

items.title: M6B Implement sanitized host proposal adapters
items.context: Add Codex CLI and Claude Code CLI primary proposers, conditional agy fallback, universal pre-egress sanitizer, bounded schema validation, and deterministic local fallback.
items.userSees: Host proposals add bounded semantic keywords without exposing secret values or blocking local routing during outages.

happy.desc: Invoke candidate routing with available Codex CLI and Claude Code CLI primary proposers and a fixture that triggers conditional Antigravity CLI fallback -> each adapter uses core/host-run, accepts only bounded schema-valid sanitized proposals with provider/prompt/seed provenance, and merges advisory terms without granting gate authority; WHY: maps adapter-tests to the visible semantic-enrichment behavior and canonical host policy

edge.desc: Simulate one and both primary hosts unavailable, timed out, quota-limited, malformed, oversized, or disagreeing -> failures are recorded, agy is used only under policy, proposal term/ambiguity/rationale budgets are enforced, and deterministic local routing still returns candidates without an automatic full scan; WHY: maps host-failure-tests to graceful local fallback

adversarial.desc: Place secret-like values in Story/checklist prose, backticks, paths/titles, config/error text, deterministic terms and sourceRef provenance, and return secret-like or prompt-injected host output -> the single non-bypassable pre-egress sanitizer sends names not values, hashes/omits sensitive provenance, skips uncertain calls, rejects unsafe output without persistence/ranking influence, and leakage fixtures observe zero secret bytes for Codex, Claude, and agy; WHY: maps egress-leakage-tests to the security boundary

items.title: M6C Implement bounded local search and deterministic ranker
items.context: Plan bounded queries, search filenames headings and bodies locally, score deterministically, deduplicate aliases, and surface cutoff ambiguity and negative controls.
items.userSees: Relevant specifications are ranked into a bounded candidate set with explicit reasons and escalation on ambiguity.

happy.desc: Route golden Story/spec pairs through filename, heading, exact-body, normalized, host-semantic, pair, and negative-control query stages -> the deterministic scorer ranks known relevant documents with versioned reasons/provenance, deduplicates aliases, and emits at most 8 ordinary full-read candidates from at most 10 query groups; WHY: maps ranker-tests and search-budget-tests to the bounded ranked-candidate user result

edge.desc: Run sparse, noisy/excessive, zero-hit, truncated-result, legacy-synonym, negative-control, host-disagreement, and rank-8/rank-9 tie fixtures -> low source-class coverage, cutoff ties, material truncation, missing high-confidence legacy hits, and disagreement produce explicit ambiguity signals and structured escalation rather than silent omission; WHY: maps ambiguity-fixtures across the documented retrieval boundaries

adversarial.desc: Add an irrelevant 5 MB Markdown file and adversarial high-frequency terms intended to flood results or manipulate scores -> per-query hit caps, deduplication, negative-control penalties and deterministic tie-breaking hold, prompt/full-read bytes remain bounded, and any ranking-affecting truncation escalates without serializing the corpus; WHY: proves hostile corpus noise cannot recreate token exhaustion or bypass ranking limits

items.title: M6D Implement signed candidate artifact and mechanical read evidence
items.context: Persist versioned candidateSpecSet and reviewer read artifacts, reconcile declared manifests with mechanical logs, bind digests and freshness, and fail closed on missing stale forged or mismatched evidence.
items.userSees: Review coverage claims are backed by current signed candidate and actual-read evidence rather than self-reported prose.

items.title: M6E Integrate bounded routing into PLAN scope review
items.context: Route scope-plan review through CLI candidates while preserving corpus filename enumeration, open questions, full-scan escalation, and scope-check gate semantics.
items.userSees: PLAN review reads bounded relevant documents by default and records why any broad scan was required.

items.title: M6F Reuse routing evidence across REVIEW and delivery lanes
items.context: Share current candidate digest across eligible lanes, preserve reviewer ownership, reroute on diff or corpus drift, and suppress duplicate findings without weakening lane independence.
items.userSees: Behavior docs coverage and delivery reviewers reuse current routing evidence without overlapping authority or losing findings.

items.title: M6G Implement shadow warn enforce rollout and rollback
items.context: Add canonical configuration, metrics, equivalence and recall gates, staged modes, process-fact contracts, and rollback to tool-driven broad review that never restores corpus prompt embedding.
items.userSees: Operators can progress from shadow to warn to enforce only after quality and cost thresholds pass, with a safe non-injection rollback.
